summary: SL Science Holding Ltd (issuer) filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its business combination between SL BIO Ltd. and SPAC Horizon Space Acquisition II Corp., approved by SPAC shareholders on February 12, 2026. The combined entity's ordinary shares began trading on Nasdaq under ticker SLBT on June 15, 2026. The transaction implies an equity valuation of SL Bio of approximately $5.568 billion, with a concurrent $7.8 million PIPE financing. The combined company is led by CEO/Chairman William Wang and a reconstituted board with independent directors. This is a completed SPAC de-SPAC transaction; the closing event itself is now in effect. Risk-arb angle: given closing is completed and shares are trading, the focus shifts to post-merger operational execution and potential shareholder lockup expirations.
